TRUMP_BUILD.title: Build
TRUMP_BUILD.description: Raise your [gold]Wall[/gold] by this much. Every [blue]10[/blue] height is a [gold]Section[/gold].
TRUMP_SECTION.title: Section
TRUMP_SECTION.description:
Every [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Wall[/gold] height. Each Section gives [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the end of your turn.
Stages at [blue]10[/blue], [blue]25[/blue], [blue]45[/blue] and [blue]70[/blue] unlock perks for the rest of combat.
TRUMP_DEPORT.title: Deport
TRUMP_DEPORT.description:
If the enemy's HP is at or below [blue]25%[/blue] of its Max HP, it leaves combat.
Deported enemies drop no [gold]Gold[/gold]. Bosses are immune.
TRUMP_PAY_GOLD.title: Pay Gold
TRUMP_PAY_GOLD.description: Can only be played if you have enough [gold]Gold[/gold]. Pay it when played.
